description:
Great for multi-families/parents & kids/work groups. Be together or have privacy. SLEEPS 11. UP-2 BR/1 BATH, living room & eat in kitchen. DOWN-3BR/1 BATH, Living & dining room & kitchen. FAB backyard w/Fire pit, Bocce & more. Central Location in East.

The space
2 completely separate living spaces. 
Downstairs is a 3 BR/1 Bath with 4 beds. Up is a 2BR (w/den or office) & 1 Bath with 2 beds and a sofa that converts to a bed. Each unit has its OWN kitchen and living room. 

3.5 Miles to Broadway / 3 Miles to Nissan Stadium / 2 Miles to 5 Points

The backyard is a fun urban oases w/ fire pit, table, grill, hammock & NEW Bocce court plus other games.   Plenty of parking for 3 cars off the street as well as on street parking.

Guest access
. Keyless coded access allows an easy 24 hour check in and check out process. Guests will receive a instructions and codes before arrival.

host_details:
My husband James and I are part of the film community here in Nashville. He is a local & I have called Nashville home since '97.   We, and our 2 kids, are avid Airbnb users both professionally & personally. We like to explore, drink lots of coffee,  eat good food, and hang with family & friends. We love being out in nature and anywhere near water.  We now have 3 full time guest homes; one in East Nashville ,  our beloved cabin JustoutofNashville at Center Hill Lake (just 90 minutes from Nashville) and our favorite home away in Whitefish, Montana. We have put together effortless, comfy, and stylish spaces that we ourselves love to stay in.  All our homes are very family & work friendly. So if you are here to work, play or just relax and recharge we have you covered.  We look forward to sharing our home with you and helping you have a fantastic stay.
